description: A small cardboard box sits on the bed in front of you, with a rubber duck and a couple of small toys nearby. The left hand steadies the box while the right hand lifts the lid open, then the right hand reaches inside and removes a small pink item and a white case, placing them on the bed to the right; next the right hand pinches and removes a block with a printed “L” from the box and sets it down near the other items while the left hand keeps the box in place.
